purpose: Route Abby service-navigation turns to grounded 211 answers, prompt-template clarification/fallback, or live agents.

nodes.question: Does the user mention immediate danger, medical emergency, self-harm, violence, or urgent shelter tonight?
Is the request about 211-style service navigation or a supported wallet/app action?
Did local 211 retrieval produce a strong match with usable evidence?
Can one missing detail, such as city/county/service type/urgency, likely improve retrieval?
After clarification or template fallback, is the user still unsupported or asking for a person?

grounded_211_answer.title: Grounded 211 Service Match
checklist: Name the matched provider or program.
Mention eligibility, intake steps, documents, phone, hours, or location only when present in evidence.
Cite the 211 source URL or document ID.
Offer to save the service or create a follow-up plan only after the user confirms.

clarifying_prompt.title: Clarify Need or Location
checklist: Explain that the answer will be grounded in 211 service records.

template_guided_fallback.title: Template-Guided Fallback
checklist: Offer a next search or direct 211 contact.

live_agent.title: Live Agent Handoff
checklist: Do not continue automated troubleshooting when urgent safety signals are present.
Hand off with the minimum necessary context.
